Aero 1.2.5 gives Aero its own browser, and it never touches yours.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.2.5_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.2.5_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.2.5-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.2.5-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## What's new

- **Aero has its own browser.** It browses in its own profile of your default browser and never uses your browser or its windows. 1.2.3's mode that worked inside your own Chrome is removed. In testing, it closed the tester's Chrome.
- **Sign in once.** Go to Settings → Tools → **Sign in to your accounts**.
  - Aero's browser opens as a normal window. Sign in to your Chrome profile (profile icon → Turn on sync) or to single sites, then press **Done**.
  - Aero stays signed in from then on.
  - When a page needs a sign-in mid-task, the same window opens on that page, and Aero continues once you're done. Aero never types your passwords.
- **The banner fits.** It now shows "*Qwen3.8-27B* is using Aero's browser", with the outline and **Stop**. Before, long model names cut off what Aero was using.
- **No more random pop-ups.** The cursor, banner and outline appear only while the Aero app itself is working.

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
